notes.title: Update on January 2, 2025, Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
1.Added the main interface and the settings menu.
  2.Added an introductory level for the game.

notes.title: Update of version 1.1.8 on December 25th, 2024
notes.notes:
1.Fix the problem that some route navigation areas during progress are inaccessible.
  2.Fix the problem that the team leader stops moving when switching routes.
  3.Fix the problem that some roads are stuck in the terrain.
  4.Increase the spawning height of enemy drones and increase the detection distance of enemy drones.

notes.title: Update of Version 1.1.7 on December 24, 2024
notes.notes:
1.After a soldier dies, the capsule will block the movement of other soldiers.
  2.The soldier's reloading animation is not synchronized with the gun's animation.
  3.The soldier's footsteps are not spatial audio.
  4.Add the occupation icon for soldiers.
  5.After a soldier blows up the terrain, he doesn't die, resulting in the inability of medics to rescue him.
  6.Fix the issue where the game ends accidentally and repeatedly.
